Monica (People Ops): Heads-up everyone 026 pilot launch: two policy changes go live May 1. TL;DR below and full docs are linked. Please read if you might be impacted.

1) Parental Leave Top-up (6-month pilot)
- What: Redwood will top up statutory parental pay to a higher leave pay level for eligible primary and secondary caregivers.
- Where: Pilot applies in US, UK, and Canada.
- Who: Full-time and part-time employees (pro-rated where applicable). Covers birth, adoption, guardianship, and surrogacy events.
- Duration: Top-up applies for up to 12 weeks of leave depending on region and local statutory entitlements.
- How to apply: File a leave request in the HR portal and check the "Top-up pilot" checkbox. HR will confirm eligibility and amounts.

2) Comp-time accrual for short off-cycle work
- What: Instead of taking PTO, you can elect to accrue comp-time for qualifying work (on-call, late-night incident support, major launches crossing time zones).
- Rules: Max accrual cap = 40 hours; use within 6 months; manager approval required to schedule comp-time; comp-time follows local law for payout at termination only.
- Request flow: Slack shortcut (/hr comp-time) or HR portal. Manager approvals are recorded in the portal.

hr-bot: Updated policy version: 2026-05-01. Policy URL: https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/2026-05-comp-time-topup

Darnell: Quick clarifying Q: If Im part-time 0.6FTE, is the top-up prorated automatically or do I need to submit a special form?

Monica (People Ops): Its auto-prorated based on your payroll FTE. The eligibility table is in the doc. If payroll records differ ping me and well reconcile.

Priya Sharma: Does comp-time affect headcount planning or approvals for long stretches? E.g., can a team manager block multiple folks using comp-time during a sprint?

Monica (People Ops): Managers approve comp-time requests. We expect teams to treat comp-time similar to PTO scheduling to avoid coverage issues. If you need a recurring exception, escalate to your director.

Liam O’Connor: Will the parental top-up apply to leave already approved but starting May 2? I have leave starting 5/3.

Monica (People Ops): Yes, leaves starting on or after May 1 are eligible. Leaves that began before May 1 are not retroactive; those will be evaluated case-by-case if you message me directly.

Darnell: Any reporting cadence? Curious how success is measured.

Monica (People Ops): Well track adoption rate, regional uptake, manager feedback, and time-to-approval. Pilot review scheduled Nov 1. We may extend or convert to a permanent policy based on those metrics.

Priya Sharma: Is comp-time visible on my HR profile so I can see balance?

hr-bot: After approval, comp-time balance appears on your HR portal "Time Off" page and on payslips where applicable.

Monica (People Ops): Office hours this Friday 1011am PT in #people-ops-office-hours for questions. Thanks all! :sparkles:
